name: US Representation Caller
normative-structure: The office answers for reaching Chinese makers by phone, email and WeChat from the establishments list, fair exhibitor lists and makers' own hiring posts, logging every contact, screening a maker and its owners before an agreement goes out, and sending the US agent, sales representative or local presence agreement once a maker agrees; and preparing optional independent FDA food-facility renewal briefs and properly scoped contracts for customers who choose that service, without treating the office as a government or U.S.-agent appointment.
